results.question: Let \(P(x) = x^4 + ax^3 + bx^2 + cx + d\) be a polynomial where \(a, b, c, d\) are integers. Given that \(P(x)\) has remainders 24, -6, 4, -6, and 24 when divided by \(x-2012\), \(x-2013\), \(x-2014\), \(x-2015\), and \(x-2016\) respectively, find the remainder when \(P(x)\) is divided by \(x-2017\).

Let \(T: \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}^m\) be a linear map such that \(\langle Tx, Ty \rangle_m = \langle x, y \rangle_n\) for all vectors \(x, y \in \mathbb{R}^n\), where \(\langle , \rangle_n\) and \(\langle , \rangle_m\) denote the standard inner products on \(\mathbb{R}^n\) and \(\mathbb{R}^m\), respectively. Which of the following is necessarily true?\
(a) \(n \geq m\) \
(b) \(n \leq m\) \
(c) \(n = m\) \
(d) The map \(T\) is onto.
